'''Hugh Brinson Gas Pipeline''', formerly known as '''Warrior Gas Pipeline''', is a gas pipeline under construction in the United States.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php#pipelines|title=Natural Gas - Pipeline Projects|date=2025-07-01|website=eia.gov|url-status=live|access-date=2025-09-24}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from the Permian Basin to the Dallas, TX area.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oilandgaswatch.org/pipeline/5092|title=EIP Oil & Gas Watch|website=oilandgaswatch.org|language=en|access-date=2025-09-24}}</ref>

==Background==

The pipeline was first proposed in 2022.<ref name=":0" /> As of February 2024, Energy Transfer Partner's Warrior Pipeline had "commitments for about 25% of its capacity."<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/14305366/energy-transfers-warrior-permian-natural-gas-pipeline-25-committed|title=Energy Transfer’s Warrior Permian natural gas pipeline 25% committed|last=Smith|first=Christopher E.|date=2024-02-19|website=Oil & Gas Journal|language=en|access-date=2024-08-24}}</ref> The proposed pipeline has been planned to "access almost every major city gate in the state of Texas," running from Odessa, in the Permian basin, to Fort Worth, Texas, for continued transport to the Gulf Coast.<ref name=":2" /> The pipeline would be able to potentially transport gas to Lake Charles LNG terminal via Energy Transfer's trunkline.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://naturalgasintel.com/news/energy-transfer-pushing-ahead-with-warrior-natural-gas-pipeline-to-expand-gulf-coast-transport/|title=Energy Transfer Pushing Ahead with Warrior Natural Gas Pipeline to Expand Gulf Coast Transport|date=2024-02-16|website=naturalgasintel.com|language=en|access-date=2024-08-24}}</ref> 

The Warrior pipeline will be constructed through a combination of repurposing existing pipelines and building loops.<ref name=":2" /> Construction of the pipeline is expected to be completed two years after the final investment decision (FID) for the project is reached.<ref name=":2" /> Energy Transfer is expecting FID to be reached by the end of 2024.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://naturalgasintel.com/news/energy-transfer-looking-to-sanction-warrior-natural-gas-pipeline-this-year/|title=Energy Transfer Looking to Sanction Warrior Natural Gas Pipeline This Year|date=2024-08-13|website=naturalgasintel.com|language=en|access-date=2024-08-24}}</ref>

FID was reached in December 2024. The pipeline was renamed the Hugh Brinson Pipeline, and construction began in 2025.<ref name=":1" />
